claim: A DB deputy commissioner, Mashiur Rahman, told Prothom Alo in February 2024 that the three arrested travellers admitted they were first going to Qatar on fake visas and were then to go on illegally to France, Italy and Greece, and that each had paid a broker BDT 16 to 18 lakh.

claim: According to DB in February 2024, low-ranking employees of various agencies working at Dhaka airport and people from private airlines had formed a ring that sent people from Bangladesh to the Middle East, Europe and elsewhere on fake visas for lakhs of taka; one of the two arrested men, Kabir Hossain, was a booking assistant of Qatar Airlines (printed as 'Qatar Airlines') and the other, Asaduzzaman, a security worker at Shahjalal airport, the DB officer said.
